title: bupleurum ranunculoides var. laricense
intro:
Bupleurum ranunculoides var. laricense, commonly known as Bupleurum chinense var. laricense, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae, traditionally used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum ranunculoides var. laricense include immunomodulation, anti-inflammatory activity, and potential hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
